repositories.name: Multi-Dimensional Risk Scoring
repositories.description: Risk scoring models integrating operational, financial, and behavioral data from PMS, POS, CRM, and booking platforms across a multi-property hospitality portfolio, paired with Power BI dashboards for leadership prioritization.

repositories.name: Financial Risk Forecasting Pipeline
repositories.description: Time-series forecasting with ARIMA and Prophet to support financial risk planning, plus ensemble ML (stacking, blending) to improve robustness on heterogeneous, incomplete operational data.

repositories.name: Churn Prediction & Risk Segmentation
repositories.description: Customer churn models using Logistic Regression and XGBoost reaching 87% accuracy on noisy, multi-source data, with K-Means/RFM segmentation to target retention and mitigation strategies.

repositories.name: Healthcare Claims Fraud Detection
repositories.description: Predictive models to flag high-risk insurance claims and fraud patterns for Cigna Healthcare, contributing to a 68% improvement in fraud detection and a 30% reduction in operational costs.
